summary: Phase 22 Assignments module end-to-end validation on LPGS (live). Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase22_live.py (8 tests, all pass) and re-ran /app/backend/tests/test_phase22.py sandbox suite (6/6 pass). Validated the full acceptance loop: subject-teacher prasad27 creates Grade 8-A Mathematics 'TEST_ASG_P22_Algebra' max_marks=25 counts_toward_report=ON; unrelated teachers manoj & sreeja get 403 on create AND on reading the submission inbox; max_marks<1 → 422. g8student submits a PDF; verify-without-score → 400; score 99 (>max) → 400; score -1 → 400; score 21 → 200 and stored. Admin GET /api/students/{g8student_id}/report-card contains the assignment under assignment_scores Mathematics block with {score:21, max_marks:25}, while a second untagged (counts_toward_report=OFF) verified assignment with score 8/10 is correctly absent. Redo path: redo without feedback → 400; redo with feedback clears score and sets status=redo; student resubmit bumps version→2 and status→submitted. Close/reopen: closed blocks submit with 400 ('Submissions closed'), reopen restores. GET /students/{id}/assignment-stats returns assigned/verified counts and non-null avg_score. Phase 21 homework regression smoke: GET /api/homework still returns 200 for prasad27 (no regression from _store_hw_files base-param change). Frontend verified: Teacher Assignments page (data-testid teacher-assignments-page) renders, create dialog opens with all testids present (assignment-class-select, assignment-title-input, assignment-due-input, assignment-maxmarks-input default 25, assignment-counts-toggle, assignment-files-input, assignment-create-submit); 4 live-created assignment cards appear with CLOSED/On report chips and Submissions/Reopen buttons. Student portal Assignments tab (portal-nav-assignments → portal-assignments) shows the 4 live assignments with correct status badges including 'SCORED 21/25' (tagged with gold-star 'On report' icon) and 'SCORED 8/10' (untagged, no star). Scope correct (only Grade 8-A rows visible).

issues: Due-date field uses the native browser datetime-local picker (<input type="datetime-local">) instead of the shadcn date picker used elsewhere — same inconsistency flagged for Phase 21 homework (iterations 13 & 14). Not a bug, cosmetic consistency.
Score entry uses window.prompt() (per spec) rather than an in-app shadcn dialog — functional but jarring vs the rest of the UI. Low priority.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Replace native datetime-local due-date input in TeacherAssignments.jsx CreateDialog with the shadcn date-time picker for visual consistency.
(Optional, non-blocking) Consider replacing window.prompt-based score entry with an in-app shadcn dialog containing numeric input + feedback field.
critical_code_review_comments: Permission model is correctly enforced end-to-end: _teaches_subject reused from Phase 21 blocks manoj (HS, no Maths assignment) and sreeja (LP) with 403, same as homework.
Verify endpoint correctly rejects verified-without-score (400), out-of-range score (400), and redo-without-feedback (400); redo correctly clears score to None.

Report-card integration is clean: _assignment_report_scores filters on counts_toward_report AND status=verified, grouped by subject, with {title, score, max_marks} items. Verified live: tagged present, untagged absent.

Submit endpoint now returns the full submission object (id, version, status, late) — resolves the Phase 21 action-item from iteration_14 (although the Phase 21 /homework/submit still returns only {message, late}).
server.py now 6898 lines — flagged for several iterations. Still single-file; please split into routers (homework, assignments, portal, teacher, admin, principal, marks, auth).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (teacher page + create dialog testids present, cards render with CLOSED/On report chips, student portal shows correct SCORED N/max badges with ⭐ for tagged)
